mobbin:8b62ccef-2298-47f2-8193-d740fac35.summary: User opens the Favourites home, then the Devices list where rooms group device tiles and an Offline light is visible without drilling in; later the same list shows devices online.
steal: Step 2: Offline shows on the room tile itself (gray card + Offline label + warning triangle) — no drill-in needed to see the problem.
Step 2–3: Devices grouped under room headers (Living room) with status on the tile (On • 100% vs Offline).
Step 1: Favourites Reorder + Edit as explicit widget customization entry points.
Step 1–3: Home location switcher in the header for multi-site centers.
avoid: Steps 3–4 are a duplicate all-online Devices capture — do not treat the repeat as a distinct state transition.
mobbin:8b62ccef-2298-47f2-8193-d740fac35.fit: Room-grouped device tiles with Offline-on-list extend Center Overview on the dashboard and hand off problem rooms to Recording for AV/device check; Favourites Reorder/Edit is dashboard-only widgets, not a replacement for module tiles.

mobbin:b173bbc8-5ec9-487b-9837-c0b19fc34.summary: User opens Hue Bridge device settings (room assignment + metadata), opens a Help/Feedback sheet, then lands on a searchable Help hub with articles and Contact us.
steal: Step 1: Device detail ties Name / Home / Room and shows Connected through + Device type for tech troubleshooting.
Step 3: Fix path is a help-article list (e.g. Nest camera Wi-Fi) plus Search Help — not a guided per-step wizard.
Step 3: Who to call is offered via Contact us and Ask the Help Community.
avoid: Help is a generic article list after the fact — no problem-specific guided fix from the Offline tile itself.
mobbin:b173bbc8-5ec9-487b-9837-c0b19fc34.fit: Device metadata and room assignment live on the dashboard system-health strip; Contact us maps to calling sim tech / AV support, while deep camera/mic repair still hands off to Recording.
